name: (16+) East Brickton [Season 4]
desc:
A serious roleplay game inspired by GTA:SAMP Text Based roleplay communities! A one of a kind experience never before found on Roblox. Become immersed within the world of East Brickton, a sandbox-experience created for you to live a second life through this wacky world. The decisions you make with your character will forever impact you, others, and the overall lore of the roleplay timeline. What story will you tell?

This means the game is entitled to:
-Bugs, Stat Resets, Updates, Server Resets

Welcome to East Brickton, a sprawling city set in the modern 21st century. A city based on Buffalo NY, You create and customize your character how YOU want to, and YOU choose its destiny. Rather you live life as the city's best detective or as the most infamous criminal, all decisions are yours. You control your characters destiny, and you become what you want to become!

Tags; Realistic Roleplay, EB, SA-MP, Roleplay, RP, Simulator, Life, Real World Roleplay
